description: This file defines the OrderTotalSummary class which models the summary of order totals including subtotal, total, tax, and other fees. It serves as a data container for order total calculations and is part of the order model package.

classes.name: OrderTotalSummary
classes.description: A serializable class representing the summary of an order's total costs, including subtotal, total, tax, and other associated totals.

methods.name: getSubTotal
methods.description: Returns the subtotal amount for the order.

methods.name: setSubTotal
methods.description: Sets the subtotal amount for the order.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the final total amount for the order.

methods.name: setTotal
methods.description: Sets the final total amount for the order.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Returns the list of additional totals such as taxes and fees.

methods.name: setTotals
methods.description: Sets the list of additional totals such as taxes and fees.
